about: Grok CLI session transcript study (2026-10-20). Structure-only: key names, value types, counts and fixed enums from ~/.grok on this Mac, plus the bundled product docs, strings in the installed binary and official web sources. No content values, prompts, commands, paths, project or branch names, titles, urls or ids are recorded. Helper scripts ran with python3 -I from the session scratchpad; sqlite files were opened read-only; nothing under ~/.grok was modified; grok was run only with --version and --help. No Grok session was running during the study (newest transcript write about 66 h old), so live-append behaviour is inferred, not observed.
product: xAI (SpaceXAI) official 'Grok Build' terminal coding agent, not a community grok-cli. Evidence: `grok --help` first line 'Grok Build TUI'; bundled README '# Grok' installs via the x.ai/cli install script and documents TUI, headless (`grok -p`) and ACP agent mode (`grok agent stdio`); binary is a Rust Mach-O whose strings carry crate paths crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager and xai-grok-shell; GitHub xai-org/grok-build (Rust, Apache-2.0) names the build artifact xai-grok-pager shipped as `grok`; tool metadata namespace in transcripts is `grok_build` (28,834 of 29,125 tool calls). The transcript format is the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) session/update stream plus xAI extensions.

findings.count: 127,645 lines, all with exactly {method, params, timestamp}; method session/update 106,869, _x.ai/session/update 20,776
findings.notes: ACP kinds (tool_call, tool_call_update, agent_thought_chunk, agent_message_chunk, user_message_chunk, plan, current_mode_update) use method session/update; every xAI extension kind uses _x.ai/session/update. `timestamp` is unix SECONDS (10 digits, 127,645/127,645); params._meta.agentTimestampMs is ms. params._meta on ACP kinds carries promptId (turn id), eventId, turnStartMs, streamStartMs, totalTokens, updateType (ToolCall | ToolCallUpdate | AgentThoughtChunk | AgentMessageChunk | Plan) and updateParams; extension kinds carry only {agentTimestampMs, eventId}. agentTimestampMs steps backwards by more than 1 s 1,075 times, so file order is authoritative. The first record of every file is a hook_execution (105/105).

findings.count: permission_requested 28,939; permission_resolved 28,936 (allow 28,865, deny 71); allow wait_ms median 0, p90 13 ms, 2,853 allows waited >= 1 s; deny wait_ms median 21.6 s. Per tool_started group: started + permission_prompt phase + requested + resolved 28,936; started with no permission records 139; requested but never resolved 3.
findings.notes: Almost every tool start (28,939 of 29,080) gets a permission record; auto-approved ones resolve in ~0 ms. permission_* records carry tool_name but no id; tool_completed carries tool_call_id. Pairing by order works: the tool_call name sequence in updates.jsonl equals the tool_started sequence in events.jsonl in 102/105 sessions (2 mismatches, 1 prefix). For waits >= 1 s (2,238 with order-verified ground truth), updates.jsonl writes the tool_call in the same integer-second `timestamp` as permission_requested in 2,215 (22 a second later, 1 a second earlier; that clock cannot order records within a second), and params._meta.agentTimestampMs puts the call at or before the request in 2,238/2,238 (median 83 ms). The first tool_call_update carries an agentTimestampMs a median 18.8 s before the resolution (2,238/2,238 before it), but its write `timestamp` falls in the resolution's second or later in 2,218/2,238 (1,170 in a later second, 1,048 in the same second; 20 provably earlier). So the lead is an agent-clock stamp, not write order: during an open prompt updates.jsonl normally holds only that tool's tool_call, and updates.jsonl alone still cannot tell 'awaiting approval' from 'running' (P5g gate recount, 2026-10-21; this replaces the earlier 'first update BEFORE the human answers, median 18.9 s' reading). A permission_requested without permission_resolved = a permission prompt is open (the decider may be a person or Grok's automatic review; no field names it).

Its completion is written after subagent_spawned in 52/62 and before it in 10/62, so accept either order. Child transcripts are ordinary updates.jsonl files (63 turns, no subagent records of their own). Children's turn_started.session_relationship is still 'primary'.

mappingHints.session: Discover sessions/*/*/updates.jsonl across ALL cwd groups. sessionId = session directory name (== params.sessionId == summary.info.id). agent = 'grok'. isSubagent = summary.session_kind in {subagent, subagent_resume} or the id appears as child_session_id in some parent's subagent_spawned / subagents/<id>/. Accept both methods session/update and _x.ai/session/update; ignore unknown sessionUpdate kinds.
mappingHints.cwdAndProject: cwd = summary.json info.cwd (or URL-decode the group directory name; the docs' slug+hash form with a .cwd file is unverified). Feed it to the existing projectKey() (15/107 cwds are inside a `.worktrees/` checkout). Subagents inherit the parent's project; their own cwd may be a worktree in another group. Mid-session cwd changes are not represented in the transcript (summary has cwd only; binary names previous_cwd/cwd_generation).
mappingHints.title: summary.json generated_title (99/107), else session_summary, else first human prompt (<= 40). Do not use agent_name for main sessions (it is the agent profile). Subagent title: subagent_spawned.description (or meta.json description), then summary.agent_name / subagent_type.
mappingHints.branch: summary.json head_branch (104/107). worktree = name when cwd matches the worktree regex of CONTRACT 4.4; summary.worktree_label exists in the binary but was never written here.
mappingHints.prompt: user_message_chunk whose _meta has no hideFromScrollback and no syntheticPrompt -> prompt (text <= 80, still skip text starting with '<'). interjection=true is also a human prompt. Hidden <system-reminder>/<monitor-event> messages open turns but emit no prompt.
mappingHints.toolStart: tool_call -> tool_start{toolUseId: toolCallId, tool: _meta['x.ai/tool'].name (web search: 'web_search' when _meta.backend is set)}. Summaries from rawInput: read_file.target_file / search_replace.file_path / write.file_path / list_dir.target_directory -> basename; run_terminal_command.command and monitor.command are STRINGS -> first program name; web_fetch.url -> host; grep.pattern, search_tool.query; use_tool.tool_name '<server>__<tool>' -> render like mcp tools; spawn_subagent -> description/subagent_type; get_command_or_subagent_output / kill_command_or_subagent -> task ids (plumbing). Web search query only at completion (rawOutput.action.query). background = run_terminal_command rawInput.background or rawOutput.type BackgroundTaskStarted. Skip todo_write (plan event instead).
mappingHints.toolEnd: First tool_call_update with status for that toolCallId. completed -> ok, EXCEPT rawOutput.type Bash with exit_code != 0 -> failed (602 cases; events.jsonl agrees: outcome=error). failed + rawOutput -> failed (error text from rawOutput variant name / {error,message} / content first line). failed + NO rawOutput + text prefix 'Tool <x> was not executed:', 'Hook denied:', 'User rejected the execution', 'Rejected:' -> denied. exit_plan_mode completed without rawOutput -> denied (user asked to revise/abandon). Pending tools at turn_completed{cancelled} -> interrupted; pending at a later turn's first record -> abandoned. BackgroundTaskStarted and spawn_subagent results -> ok (async launch).
mappingHints.thinking: agent_thought_chunk -> thinking{text: first sentence of the summary text, durationMs: null}. Text is a reasoning SUMMARY (raw reasoning is encrypted in chat_history); empty text did not occur.
mappingHints.say: agent_message_chunk -> say (each line is a complete segment).
mappingHints.plan: plan sessionUpdate -> plan{items: entries.map({content, status}), source: new value e.g. 'grok_plan' or reuse 'update_plan'}; it is always the full list. Status enum already pending|in_progress|completed; _meta.cancelled marks cancelled items stored as completed. exit_plan_mode: plan text in rawOutput.PlanReady.plan_content (or plan.md) -> planFromMarkdown, question '이 계획대로 진행할까요?'. current_mode_update plan/default can drive a plan-mode badge.
mappingHints.question: ask_user_question -> tool_start with question = questions[0].question (+N), options = questions[0].options[].label; ended by its tool_call_update (UserAnswered -> ok).
mappingHints.turnEnd: turn_completed (_x.ai) by prompt_id: end_turn -> end_turn, cancelled -> interrupt, error -> api_error. A new promptId without a turn_completed for the previous one -> next_turn. Expect a few late tool_call_update / thought records after turn_completed.
mappingHints.subagents: From the parent: subagent_spawned{child_session_id, parent_session_id, subagent_type, description} announces the child (parentSessionId = parent dir id, agentType = subagent_type); subagent_finished{child_session_id, status} ends it (session_end done; cancelled also done). The spawn_subagent tool ends earlier (ok). meta.json is a fallback when the parent file is not tailed. The child file itself has no parent pointer in 61/62 cases, so buffer children until a parent record names them.
mappingHints.errorsDenialsInterrupts: retry_state type retrying -> system api_error 'API 재시도 <attempt>/<max_retries>'; retry_state failed and turn_completed stop_reason error -> system api_error + turn_end. Denials from the failed-without-rawOutput rule. Interrupt = turn_completed stop_reason cancelled (cancelTrigger esc/ctrl_c/send_now/shutdown/mouse). Optional: tail events.jsonl too for awaiting-approval (permission_requested with no permission_resolved yet, pair to the oldest open tool_started of that tool_name, then to tool_call order) and permission_resolved deny.
mappingHints.compact: auto_compact_started (or auto_compact_completed) -> system{kind:'compact'}; auto_compact_failed -> system api_error-like notice or ignore. Manual /compact representation unverified.
mappingHints.liveTailing: Tail updates.jsonl by byte offset (R6 framing; lines up to ~0.75 MB here, keep the 2.7 MB tolerance). mtime equals the last record time on all files, consistent with per-record appends. Never sort by timestamp (agentTimestampMs goes backwards 1,075 times). Live set: ~/.grok/active_sessions.json rows {session_id, pid, pid_start, cwd, opened_at} (binary evidence; TUI sessions only unless GROK_TRACK_HEADLESS) plus file growth; .lock files persist and mean nothing. session_end: hook_execution event_name session_end (11 of 105 files), a session_ended update (binary only), disappearance from active_sessions.json, or idle timeout. Re-read summary.json on change for title/branch. Optional second tail of events.jsonl (about 8x the line rate of updates.jsonl because of phase_changed) only for approval waits.
